about_short_description.short_description: Breadfast delivers household essentials, bakeries, groceries, fruits, veggies, and more than 3,000 items in minutes.

product.name: Breadfast Grocery and Essentials App
product.description: A mobile supermarket service for ordering more than 3,000 household products, including groceries, fresh food, personal care, baby products, stationery, pharmacy items, and home supplies.

product.name: Fresh Bakery and Food Delivery
product.description: A same-day delivery service for freshly prepared bakery items, coffee, juices, ready-to-eat meals, desserts, and prepared or frozen foods ordered through Breadfast.

product.name: Breadfast Delivery Service
product.description: An on-demand and scheduled delivery service that brings groceries, fresh food, and household essentials to customers’ doors, including immediate delivery in supported areas.

product.name: Breadfast Card
product.description: A payment and spending product connected to Breadfast that lets users shop, manage money, and receive cashback, rewards, and other account benefits.

product.name: Chef on-Demand
product.description: A chef-booking service that connects customers with vetted chefs for homemade meals, meal preparation, hosting, and other in-home food needs.

product.name: Journeys by Breadfast
product.description: A travel-booking service for weekend escapes and longer trips, offering curated destinations and travel experiences with payment in Egyptian pounds.
